text: きほんてきに　レベルが　あがると　ＨＰ　こうげき　ぼうぎょ　などの　のうりょくが　あがり　つよくなります。

structure.jp: レベルが　あがると
ＨＰ　こうげき　ぼうぎょ　などの　のうりょくが　あがり
structure.en: stats such as HP, Attack and Defense rise and

patterns.name: 〜と (when)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb says 'whenever this happens, that follows'. レベルが　あがると = 'when the level goes up'.

patterns.name: 〜ます形 (linking)
patterns.span: のうりょくが　あがり
patterns.explanation: A verb cut short like this (あがります without ます) means 'and', joining to what comes next; it sounds written. のうりょくが　あがり = 'the stats rise, and'.

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: Changing い to く and adding なる says something becomes that way. つよくなります = 'it becomes strong'.
